end.summary:
Riya gave examples of diversity in food, dress, folk music and festivals across Indian regions.
They connected harvest festivals such as Pongal and Lohri through a shared seasonal idea with different practices.
They identified shared celebration as a common thread across different kinds of folk music.
They explained unity as different people living together, like students in one class.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Riya practised identifying regional differences in language, food, dress, music and festivals, then finding shared ideas beneath them. They used harvest festivals and folk music to explain how practices can differ while the purpose or value is shared. They also connected unity in diversity to people living together in one class. At home, ask Riya to make a two-column example: “different forms” and “shared idea.”
